# @tansy/shop

Turns tansy into an online shop: products, variants, stock, categories, a cart, shipping zones, orders and fulfilment. Takes payment through @tansy/payments.

```bash
npm install @tansy/shop
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the shop plugin documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/plugins/shop.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party plugin for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
